text:
Maria L.: quick brain dump: want a tiny widget for Console showing "avg effective $/call" for a route. Should factor token unit price, cache hit reduction, and any model fallback deltas. target: help teams spot regressions without diving into raw logs.
Vikram S.: big caveat: telemetry cardinality. If we try to store per-call price attribution we’ll OOM prometheus and explode our event-store. Need rollups.
Sophie: agree. Suggest coarse-minute rollups keyed by (route, model_sku, fallback_flag, cache_bucket). cache_bucket could be coarse buckets like none, low, med, high.
AJ: for the UI, do we want avg or median? avg can be skewed by long-chains. median + p95 might be better.
Kevin: +1 median + p95. Also we should surface a small badge when >5% of calls used a fallback model in the window that changes interpretation.
Elaine: copy suggestion: "Estimated effective cost (based on sampled telemetry). Click to reconcile with invoice data." Keep it honest.
Sam: telemetry-side: we can run 0.5% sampling at the edge and write sampled event to kafka topic econ-sample. Then a nightly job extrapolates counts. That keeps storage small.
Vikram S.: sampling math: for low-volume routes 0.5% might be zero. Maybe do stratified sampling: always sample up to N calls per minute per route (min-sample), then random beyond.
AJ: SQL sketch for extrapolate:
```
SELECT route, model_sku, SUM(sample_tokens) * (total_calls / SUM(sample_count)) as est_tokens
FROM sampled_rollups JOIN route_totals USING(route,model_sku)
GROUP BY route,model_sku;
```
AJ: and then multiply est_tokens by time-weighted unit price for model_sku.
Kevin: where do we get unit price history? price-service has endpoint but add cache in the job. Also watch currency rounding and cents noise.
Maria L.: product question: do we show a single combined cost for a route or allow model-split? My inclination: default combined, expandable to model breakdown. Low visual density for main console.
Elaine: UX: a tiny sparkline + number, and a chevron to expand a micro-panel that shows model split, cache %, fallback %. In micro-panel also show toggle median/p95/mean.
Sophie: ops-mode: allow customers to opt-in to "exact reconciliation" which writes full traces for a short period and links to billing exports. Default is sampled.
Sam: infra concern: sampled events must carry a stable sample_key so we can dedupe across retries. Also include call_duration bucket so we can detect chains vs short calls.
Vikram S.: action items: infra: implement stratified sampling + sample_key (Sam), platform: nightly extrapolation job + price-lookup (AJ), runtime: surface fallback_flag in request path (Kevin), product/UX: microcopy + expand panel (Elaine).
Maria L.: open ticket PLAT-9201. I'll assign owners after this thread. Add an experiment plan: 2-week A/B for routes > X qps.
AJ: one more edge: cached KV hits reduce model runtime tokens but may increase prefetch tokens. Need to ensure our token accounting nets out prefix vs generated tokens.
Sophie: propose token categories in rollup: prefix_tokens, generated_tokens, kv_hits_count. That makes cost math clearer.
Elaine: UI microcopy update: add "includes cache offsets and routing fallbacks" in hover.
Sam: infra-bot: sampling rollout job scheduled on canary cluster Tue 02:00 UTC. Logs: https://logs.redwood/internal/rollouts/9201
Maria L.: thanks all. I'll sketch the console mock and share Monday.
Kevin: I'll demo runtime flags next Wed.
Maria L.: awesome. :thumbsup:
